summary.text: Smiley is a retired Ford Motor Company employee from Riverview who worked at the company for more than three decades in global business roles. She was the Republican nominee against Debbie Dingell in 2024 and is the Republican nominee again in 2026. Her campaign website says she decided to run because she believes the government has "progressively gone astray."

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, she attended public schools and was the first in her family to attend college, earning a bachelor's degree (1985) and a master's degree in administration (2001) from Central Michigan University.

Worked at Ford Motor Company from 1990 to 2022, including global leadership roles in data insights and analytics, product and program management, strategy and planning, and supply chain; her campaign website adds business transformation and customer service roles and work on location in Europe. Bridge Michigan describes her roles as union and salaried positions.
Describes volunteer work throughout her adult life as a first responder and instructor, youth program leader, and supporter of emergency preparedness agencies and local charities.
Was the Republican nominee against Dingell in the 2024 general election, after an uncontested primary; she is a resident of Riverview.
Describes herself on her campaign website as a Christian mother of two children.

sources.title: Debbie Dingell faces Heather Smiley in Michigan 6th Congressional District election
